lista.descripcion: Aprende Peque · Series Infantiles
The Squirrels learn what a favourite is but have trouble deciding what their own favourite things are. So they make a film asking some of their friends what is special to them to help narrow it down.
When the Squirrels see Duggee practising his impressive topiary skills they are keen to try some of their own – and promptly put their new talents into practice in order to tame some very wild woods.

lista.titulo: Hey Duggee - The A Cappella Badge
lista.descripcion: The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.
Duggee’s old friend arrives at the Clubhouse, but he has lost his Christmas cheer. He used to love Christmas, but everything seems to be getting bigger, louder and faster, and it's exhausting.

Duggee has a job to do outside the Clubhouse, but who will look after the Squirrels? King Tiger, of course, since he has his babysitting badge. But it’s actually the Squirrels who end up babysitting King Tiger.
Duggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They are eager to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued. Duggee shows the Squirrels how to create their own ending.
Learn all about the number zero with Numberblocks Zero.

lista.titulo: Numberblocks - Now We Are Six to Ten
lista.descripcion: Learn all about the numbers 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 with the Numberblocks.
Children's animation. Sing along to the Numberblocks counting song with the Numberblocks' favourite friends. Learn to count to ten with the Numberblocks.
When an alien ship crashes in Numberland, the Numberblocks decide to help the alien get back home. The alien can create lots of blocks like the Numberblocks, so they build a tower into the sky.
Children's animation. The number friends take turns hiding behind each other in a song and dance all about bigger and smaller. Learn about comparing numbers.
Children's animation. Every time Numberblock Nine hiccups, he falls to pieces- until the others find an unexpected cure. Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers.
Peg and Cat can dance with their idol Misty Copeland, if Cat can overcome a big obstacle-his tail!
Pocoyo, Pato, and Elly compete in a foot race but due to their competitive nature, they break the rules of the game and use scooters and later cars to pass the finish line first.
Pocoyo, Pato, and Elly go camping but get scared when they hear an eerie noise.

Pocoyo and Pato are playing with their Martian friend. They build a rocket ship with boxes and pretend that they are navigating through space between planets and stars. At the culmination of the mission, the Martian's parents arrive to tell him that it is time to return to his real home.

Pato is about to go away on a trip on an airplane but realizes that he has forgotten his suitcase. He calls Pocoyo and Elly and begs them to bring it as fast as possible to the airport. Will they get there in time?
Pocoyo shows up with a box full of toys: building blocks, a puzzle and a ball. His friends want to play with him, but Pocoyo won’t let them because he would rather play alone!

Durante el fin de semana, Bluey y Bingo juegan en el jardín con su padre, pero Bingo se disgusta porque encuentra a un insecto que es como una hoja, pero su padre está tan metido en el partido que no le hace caso.

Es la hora de comer en la terraza de casa de Bluey. En una barbacoa, no puede faltar la ensalada, así que el momento de tranquilidad de Bingo tendrá que esperar hasta que encuentre pimientos de todos los colores que quieren sus primas.
Como no se quiere ir a la cama, Bluey intenta soñar que es un murciélago de la fruta nocturno para poder estar despierta toda la noche. Poco después, vuela por el cielo estrellado.
Cuando Bluey olvida guardar a su juguete favorito, ¡su prima Socks lo toma y no le deja ir! Los niños arman un casamiento de caballos para distraerla, ¡con papá y tío Stripe como los caballos!

Bluey y Bingo lían a su padre para que juegue a los hoteles. Ambas regentan un hotel estrambótico y su padre hace de huésped acosado, pero cuando Bluey empieza a controlar el juego, Bingo se va, así que tiene que aprender a llegar a un acuerdo para que siga la diversión.

Bluey va al parque a aprender a montar en bici y le cuesta mucho, pero su padre y ella observan la determinación del resto de sus amigos para enfrentarse a las dificultades. Le sirven de ejemplo para volver a intentarlo.
Pip and Pop hide from Otto at daybreak and he has to find them before he can sleep. Oona, Baba and Mossy join the search party, but Baba just wants to play.

lista.titulo: Pregunte a los StoryBots - How Does Night Happen?
lista.descripcion: The StoryBots visit mountaintops, the deep sea and even outer space to understand how night happens. Jay Leno guest stars as a helpful knight.

lista.titulo: Los Octonautas en tierra firme - Pygmy Sloths
lista.descripcion: The Vegimals train as pirates to protect mangrove trees from a group of pygmy sloths.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Blue Engine Blues
lista.descripcion: A rough night's sleep and a cancelled beach day puts Thomas in the grumpiest of moods. Encountering Riff and Jiff with their usual happy-go-lucky attitudes, Thomas comes to the conclusion that he'll only be liked when he appears happy. He puts on a fake smile for the rest of the day, but his words don't match his demeanor and everyone can see right through him. Finally, Thomas comes across Riff and Jiff again, who reveal they're also upset about the cruddy day!

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Hay Fort Frenzy
lista.descripcion: Thomas gets help from Terence the Tractor and Carly to assemble all hay bales. Carly and Terence manage to get everything together quickly, but soon Terence purposefully crashes into the hay bales sending loose hay all over the place! Carly is shocked and confused. They turn the hay-bale stacking into a game, forming all kinds of structures Terence can crash into. Thomas worries they won't have enough time to complete the delivery.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Percy in the Middle
lista.descripcion: After Gordon tells all the young engines that they have a day off to relax, Thomas and Diesel insist on a teamed relay race through the obstacle course. Percy is the only one who isn't interested in playing, so Thomas asks him to referee instead. He reluctantly agrees and the race is on! Coming to a split-second finish, Percy determines Thomas' team wins, but Diesel doesn't accept and calls for a rematch. Once again the teams race and Diesel wins after accidentally causing an oil spill. Both teams become so angry with each other, they're too distracted when Percy runs off to chase butterflies. Thomas, Diesel, and friends finally notice Percy's absence and speed after him, but they'll need to learn their lesson about sportsmanship if they want to ensure this day off is a success.

lista.titulo: Thomas and Friends: trenes a todo vapor - Bad Luck Boxcar
lista.descripcion: When Thomas and Percy must transport an unlucky boxcar of bananas, Thomas seems to have bad luck. Percy's positive attitude helps Thomas see the luck in each scenario, breaking the myth of the curse for a successful delivery.

Mom Tiger helps the boys with their mad feelings and find ways to calm down and think. They take a deep breath, count to 4, and that helps them make a grr-ific new plan — to make an inside beach instead!

She gets very,very mad when someone else picks the instrument she wants to play. Music Man Stan helps Katerina find ways to deal with her mad feelings – like taking a deep breath, counting to 4 – and then dancing and stomping and singing.
